prerequisite: G quest/cinematic/audio polish must be engine-green before H target-device profiling begins.
purpose: Define the final P1C01 performance evidence pass on the real low-spec target before Gate 6/7 acceptance.
measurements: save/load and chapter transition hitch observations
fail_closed_rules: Do not increase foliage/detail density to hide visual gaps before profiling.
Do not call PERFORMANCE-ACCEPTED from desktop/high-end or synthetic evidence alone.
Any repeated hitch tied to synchronous heavy loading blocks acceptance.
Any sustained route segment below the 30 FPS floor is a profiling defect until measured and addressed.
Any VRAM pressure/texture thrash must be solved by asset/material/streaming budgets before hero-resolution expansion.
Profiling changes must not compromise locked story outcomes, traversal, save continuity or player readability.
optimization_order: remove accidental expensive features and warning debt
fix NPC/fauna activation and pooling budgets
acceptance: P1C01 route remains playable at/above the required 30 FPS floor on the target device under the tested profile.
No blocking streaming hitch, collision trap, save-continuity failure or world-state regression is present.
Human visual/pacing review is completed for the same chapter/build.
Only the evidence actually observed is promoted to DEVICE/PERFORMANCE/VISUAL acceptance.
evidence_boundary: Preparation only. No performance acceptance exists until real target-device measurements are captured.
